description: Source code implementing LWM2M server object management for Zephyr OS, including resource definitions, instance creation, and server state handling.

methods.name: disable_cb
methods.description: Callback to disable a server instance, disables server and sets disabled timeout.

methods.name: update_trigger_cb
methods.description: Callback to trigger an update of server resources.

methods.name: lwm2m_server_get_mute_send
methods.description: Retrieve mute send status for a server instance.

methods.name: lwm2m_server_get_instance_s32
methods.description: Get a 32-bit integer resource value for a server instance.

methods.name: lwm2m_server_get_pmin
methods.description: Get the minimum period for server updates.

methods.name: lwm2m_server_get_pmax
methods.description: Get the maximum period for server updates.

methods.name: lwm2m_server_get_ssid

methods.description: Convert short server ID to instance ID.

methods.name: lwm2m_server_inst_id_to_index

methods.description: Check if a server instance is enabled.

methods.description: Disable a server instance for a specified timeout.

methods.description: Select a server instance based on priority and enabled status.

methods.name: lwm2m_server_get_prio
methods.description: Get the priority of a server instance.

methods.description: Initialize the LWM2M server object and register it.
